points.description: First valid parameter affecting MRR named (e.g. frequency of vibration, amplitude of vibration, abrasive slurry concentration, abrasive particle diameter/size).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if vaguely stated (e.g. 'vibration' or 'abrasive' without specifying the parameter).

points.description: Second, different valid parameter affecting MRR named (from frequency, amplitude, slurry concentration, particle diameter).
Third, different valid parameter affecting MRR named (from frequency, amplitude, slurry concentration, particle diameter).

rubric.notes: Award marks per distinct correct parameter, three needed for full marks (2). Clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. grit size for particle diameter, abrasive concentration for slurry concentration). Repeats, wrong items (e.g. tool material not in the model answer) or unrelated answers earn nothing for that item; round the total to the nearest half mark, so one correct item gives about 1 and two correct gives about 1.5 or 1.
